paite: Huan akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai a dingh akhente, Pathian lalgam thilhihtheihna toh hong tung amuh ma ua, sihna chiam lou ding a-om uh," achi hi.
heading: Mellamdanna / (Mat 17.1-13; Luk 9.28-36)
english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”

paite: Huan ni guk nung in Jesu'n Peter, Jakob leh Johan apituam a, tang sangtak ah apaitouhpih a; ama uah amel omdan ahong lamdangta hi.
english: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.

paite: Huchi in apuansilhte lei a puansawpmi in asawp ngou theih louh khop hial a ngou velvol in ahong lamdangta hi.
english: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.

paite: Akiang uah Elijah leh Mosi ahong kilak ua, Jesu toh akihou uhi.
english: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.

paite: Peter in Jesu ahoupih a, "Heutupa, ei a ding in hiai a om ahoih; aidakbuk thum i lam ding ua, nang a ding in khat, Mosi a ding in khat, Elijah a ding in khat," achi hi.
english: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

paite: Alau mahmah ziak un agen pen leng athei kei hi.
english: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.

paite: Huan amau liah in meipi ahong kai a; meipi a pan aw ahong suak a, "Hiai ka Tapa deihtak ahi, amah thu ngai un," achi hi.
english: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”

paite: Kintak in akimvel a-en ua, akiang ua Jesu kia lou ngal kuamah amuta kei uhi.
english: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.

paite: Huan tang a kipan apaisuk lai un, "Misi lak a kipan Mihing Tapa athohnawn khit mateng athil muhte uh kuamah hilh louh ding," achi bikbek hi.
english: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

paite: Huchi in huai thu avom kinken uhi, misi lak a pan thohnawn pen bang chihna hi ding ahia chih akidong uhi.
english: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, "Bangchidan a laigelhmite'n, Elijah ahong pai masa ding ahi," chi ahi ua? chi in adong uhi.
english: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Bangkim bawlhoih thak ding in Elijah ahong pai masa him ahi; ahihleh thil tampi athuak ding a, muhdah a mawkbawl in a-om ding chi a Mihing Tapa tungthu bangchidan a gelh a na om ahia le? achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?

paite: Himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, Elijah zaw ahong pai khinta hi, atanchin agelh bang ngei un atung ah a-utut un ahih khinta uhi,” achi hi.
english: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”

paite: Huan nungzuite kiang atunsuk un, akim ua mipi tampite leh laigelhmite ana kisel lai uh amu uhi.
heading: Pasal Naupang Dawimat Hihdamna / (Mat 17.14-21; Luk 9.37-43)
english: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

paite: Mipi tengteng in amah amuhtak un lamdang asa mahmah ua, akiang ah atai pah ua, chibai ava buk kheukhou uhi.
english: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Amaute toh bang thu ahia na na kisel uh?" chi in adong hi.
english: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”

paite: Mipi lak a mi khat in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, ka tapa, dawi mat pau thei lou dia abawl, na kiang ah ka hon pi a;
english: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;

paite: amatna peuh ah apuksak ekek a; huchi in achilphuan pawt in, aha agawi a, ahong kongkaw a; na nungzuite'n delhkhe le uh ka chihleh adelhkhe thei kei uh," achi hi.
english: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Ginna nei lou khangte aw, bang tan na kiang ua om ding a bang tan hon thuak thei ding ka hia? Amah ka kiang ah hon pi un," chi in adawng hi.
english: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”

paite: Huan amah Jesu kiang ah ahon pi ua; dawi in amah amuhtak in nakpi in naupang asawisa pah a; huchi in lei ah apuk a, achilphuan kai zezu in akikhuk volvol hi.
english: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.

paite: Huan ama'n apa kiang ah, "Hichibang a ahong kipatna bang tan ahita a?" chi in adong hi. Ama'n, "Anaupan lai a kipan ahita,"
english: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?” He said, “From childhood.

paite: "Huchi in amah hihmangthang ding in tamveipi mei ah leh tui ah asawnpuk a; himahleh nang bangchi chi hiam bek a na hihtheihleh hon hehpih inla, hon huh in," achi hi.
english: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Na gintakleh e! Agingtami a ding in bangkim hihtheih ahi," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

paite: Huchi in naupang' pa'n khitui toh, "Toupa, ka gingta hi, ka ginlahna hon huh in," chi in akikoukhia hi.
english: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”

paite: Jesu'n mipi hong taikhawm amuh in, dawi nin atai a, akiang ah, "Nang dawi pau thei lou leh nangong, thu ka hon pia hi, asung a kipan pawt inla, lut nawn ke'n," achi hi.
english: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”

paite: Huchi in akikoukheta a, nakpitak a asawi khit in apawtta a, naupang misi bang in a-om a; huchi in mi tamzawte'n, "Asi ahi," achi uhi.
english: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”

paite: Jesu'n akhut alen a, akaithou a; huan ahong thou maimahta hi.
english: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.

paite: Huan Jesu inn a ava lutleh anungzuite'n, "Bangchi a kou delhkhe thei lou ka hi ua?" chi in asim in adong uhi.
english: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hichibang zaw thumna leh an ngawlna kia lou ngal in bangchi mah in apawt thei kei,” achi hi.
english: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting.”

paite: Huan huai a kipan apaikhia ua; Galili gam paikan in, kuamah theih adeih kei,
heading: Sih Ding Agenkholh Nihveina / (Mat 17.22-23; Luk 9.43-45)
english: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it,

paite: anungzuite asinsak lai ahih ziak in akiang uah, "Mihing Tapa mihingte khut ah matsak in a-om dia, athat ding ua; ahihlup nung uh ni thum nung in athounawn ding," achi ngal a.
english: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”

paite: Himahleh athugen atheisiam kei ua, amah lah adong ngam kei uhi.
english: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.

paite: Huan Kapernaum khua ahong tung ua; insung a a-om lai in, akiang uah, "Lampi a bang thu ahia na kisel uh?" chi in adong hi.
heading: Kingainiam Dia Thuhilhna / (Mat 18.1-5; Luk 9.46-48)
english: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”

paite: Lampi ah, i lak uah kua i thupipen dia? chi a ana kisel khit ziak un adai dide uhi.
english: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.

paite: Huan amah atu a, sawm-le-nihte asam a, akiang uah, "Kuapeuh in masapen hih a-utleh mi tengteng sang in ananungpen in a-om ding ahi, mi tengteng nna sem in a-om ding ahi," achi hi.
english: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”

paite: Huan naupang chik khat akai a, alak uah adingsak a; apom a akiang uah,
english: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,

paite: "Kuapeuh ka min ziak a hiai bang naupang chik khat kipahpih keimah hon kipahpih ahi a, kuapeuh kei hon kipahpih zaw, kei hon kipahpih ahi kei ding, hon sawlpa kipahpih ahi zaw uh," achi hi.
english: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”

paite: Johan in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, kuahiam na min a dawite delhkhia ka mu ua; ahon zuih louh ziak in ka kham uhi," achi hi.
heading: Na Lam A Pangte Thei In / (Luk 9.49-50)
english: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”

paite: Jesu'n, "Kham nawn kei un; kuamah ka min a thil thupi hih kei hon gense pah thei a-om kei hi.
english: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

paite: Kuapeuh ei hon dou lou i lam a pang ahi.
english: For whoever is not against us is on our side.

paite: Kuapeuh Khrist mi na hih ziak ua tui nou khat dawn ding hon pia, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, akipahman atan kei hial ding hi.
english: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.

paite: "Huan kuapeuh hon gingta neuchikte lak a khat leng hihpuk, angawng ah buh gawizanna suang lianpi oksak in tuipi ah khe le uh, amah a ding in ahoihzaw ding hi.
heading: Pukna Leh Gehenna Mei / (Mat 18.6-9; Luk 17.1-2)
english: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.

paite: Huan na khut in ahon hihpukleh tankhia in; melhem a hinna a lut nang ding in ahoihzaw, khut nih nei a gawtmun mei mit thei lou a pai sang in,
english: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

paite: athan uh asih louh a, meikuang mihlouhna ah.
english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

paite: Na khe in ahon hihpukleh tankhia in, khe nih nei a gawtmun a paih a om sang in, khebai a hinna a lut nang a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
english: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—

paite: Athan uh asih louh a, meikuang amihlouhna ah.
english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

paite: Huan na mit in ahon hihpukleh khelkhia in; mit langnih nei a gawtmun a paih a om sang in mit langkhat nei a Pathian lalgam a lut nang a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
english: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,

paite: Athan uh sih ngeilouhna leh mei mih ngeilouhna ah.
english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

paite: Michih mei a soh a om ding uh ahi ngal a.
english: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

paite: Chi ahoih hi; himahleh, chi apen khitleh bang in na hih al nawn ding ua? Noumau ngei ah chi nei unla, khat-le-khat kilem in om un," achi hi.
english: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”
